factor_modifiers.name: Quality Tier Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Time multiplier based on quality tier selection per Modifier_Registry.md
factor_modifiers.notes: QT modifiers increase TIME, not rate. Applied to qt_scaled tasks only. Binary tasks unaffected.

factor_modifiers.name: Profile Complexity Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Time multiplier based on trim profile complexity per Millwork_NC_Paint_Doctrine Section 7.2
factor_modifiers.notes: Simple (flat/square edge) = 0.85x time (faster). Standard (ogee/cove) = baseline. Complex (multi-piece/built-up) = 1.25x time. Ornate (dentil/egg-and-dart) = 1.40x time.

factor_modifiers.name: Height Modifier for Trim
factor_modifiers.description: Time multiplier based on trim working height per Modifier_Registry.md

height_ranges.H2_TALL: 9-12ft - step/extension ladder for crown, high casings
height_ranges.H3_HIGH: 13-17ft - scaffold likely for elevated trim work

factor_modifiers.notes: Primarily affects crown molding and high casing work. Standard baseboard/casing at floor level uses H1 baseline.

factor_modifiers.name: Substrate State Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Time multiplier for prep tasks based on existing coating state per Modifier_Registry.md
factor_modifiers.notes: Substrate state modifiers apply primarily to prep tasks. Prime and finish remain at 1.0 because prep normalizes the surface. Glossy/oil substrates require more degloss sanding effort.

critical_constraints.mdf_edge_seal_mandatory: MDF edges MUST receive solvent-based sealer (shellac or oil-based) BEFORE any latex products. Water-based primers cause irreversible fiber raise on MDF edges.
critical_constraints.fjp_stain_block_mandatory: FJP (Finger-Joint Pine) MUST receive stain-blocking primer. Without stain-blocking, resin bleed-through will appear within weeks/months.
critical_constraints.primer_is_substrate_driven: Primer selection is driven by substrate_condition dimension, NOT quality tier. Per Fine_Finish_Doctrine Section 2.1.
critical_constraints.application_quality_not_tiered: Application quality is the same at all quality tiers. Drips, sags, holidays fail at QT3 just as at QT5. QT controls inspection scrutiny and pace, not application standards.

production_notes.rate_derivation: Rates derived from Millwork_NC_Paint_Doctrine Section 7.1, PaintFactor_Production_Rate_Reference, and Fine_Finish_Doctrine production guidance. Base rates calibrated to QT3 standard profile.
production_notes.modifier_application: All modifiers are TIME MULTIPLIERS applied via effective_rate = base_rate / modifier. Higher modifiers = slower effective rate = more time required.
production_notes.quality_expression: Quality differences expressed through qt_rates scaling. QT3 is baseline (1.0), QT4 is 1.3x time, QT5 is 1.5x time per Modifier_Registry.
production_notes.lf_to_sf_equivalence: Per PDCA standard, 1 LF trim = 1 SF regardless of actual width (Millwork_NC_Paint_Doctrine Section 1.3).
production_notes.profile_complexity_impact: Profile complexity significantly affects prep and prime time. Ornate profiles can take 40% longer than standard profiles.
